answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 23 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The forge schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the yarrow checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Someone wanting 185 effective identities must lock that capital for 23 epochs and keep it locked through every velvet audit. That is 21 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
